svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "The nucleus."], [1, "Its envelope is a double membrane; the outer membrane joins the rough ER."], [3, "Nuclear pores control traffic in and out."], [5, "mRNA and ribosome subunits leave through the pores..."], [8, "...and proteins made in the cytoplasm, such as histones and DNA polymerase, come in."], [11, "Inside: chromatin, dense near the envelope, and the nucleolus."]]
svg.title: The nucleus
svg.desc: A nucleus with a double-membrane nuclear envelope continuous with the rough ER, nuclear pores through which mRNA and ribosome subunits leave and proteins enter, chromatin and a nucleolus.
svg.text: Section through a nucleus, about 6 µm across.

g.data-info: DNA wrapped round histone proteins. Densely packed heterochromatin (dark, mostly near the envelope) is less active; loose euchromatin is being transcribed.
Dense region where ribosomal RNA is made and ribosome subunits are assembled.
A double membrane. The outer membrane is continuous with the rough ER and has ribosomes on it.
Large protein complexes spanning both membranes. mRNA and ribosome subunits leave; proteins such as DNA polymerase and histones enter.
Continuous with the outer membrane of the nuclear envelope.
